_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to .architect-team-deploy.json (gitignored, local per checkout) to opt this project into the v3.44.0 dev -> test-on-dev -> prod discipline. Fields: prod_deploy.enabled gates the whole discipline; prod_branch is the production branch (default 'main'); always_merge_to_prod_on_complete makes every clean run auto-merge to prod_branch on completion; deploy_command (null = 'prod' is just the merge to prod_branch) is a shell command run AFTER dev is green to perform a real external deploy; health_check_url (optional) is polled after the deploy. tests.always_run lists test ids or fnmatch globs (e.g. 'tests/test_billing*', 'e2e/prod-checks/*') the impact-based selector (scripts/test_index/) selects at EVERY phase regardless of what changed; tests.full_suite_at lists the phases at which the full suite runs (default ['phase-8']; Phase 8 is always a full-suite phase). These test pins are HUMAN-OWNED: an agent may read them and may never lower, remove, or narrow them. IMMUTABLE TO AGENTS: once this file exists the pipeline and every subagent may READ it but may NEVER create, edit, disable, delete, or skip it on their own initiative -- only a HUMAN may change it (edit the file, or pass --no-prod / 'don't touch prod' for a single run). An agent overriding this is a v3.44.0 unilateral-override violation the PreToolUse guard blocks.
